name: openbb_economy_leading
description:
OECD composite leading indicator for a country (turning-point signal; 100 = long-term trend) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.composite_leading_indicator).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (e.g. united_states, g20; default united_states); start_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (oecd; default oecd).
US index: fred_leading_index. Keys: oecd needs none.
Example: {"country": "g20"}

country.description: Country, lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, japan

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
